verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS expense platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The pack shows only a REST Integration Server API with partner credentials and OAuth2, plus in-app AI features such as Ask Expensify and Concierge. These are adjacent building blocks or other features, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
